integrity: Analytical spherical-excess, incidence and derivative arguments, with deterministic independent edge-crossing numerical tests; no claim of independent external certification.
scientific_limitations: Right prisms with equilateral bases, Haar-uniform central planes only. No assertion for translations, oblique prisms, arbitrary bases, or other section observables. Analogous 2023–2024 angle-density study could not be inspected in full; independent validation is unperformed.
title: Complete central-section polygon law and unique pentagon optimum for equilateral triangular prisms
